results.title: Tragic Incident in Manipur: 11 Lives Lost Due to Adulterated Liquor
results.description: In a heartbreaking incident in Manipur's Chandel district, 11 people have died and over 180 are hospitalized after consuming adulterated liquor. Chief Minister Y Khemachand Singh has visited the affected patients and assured thorough investigations. A health advisory has been issued, urging the public to avoid questionable alcoholic beverages and seek medical help for any symptoms. The government is taking steps to ensure accountability and improve public safety. This tragic event highlights the urgent need for awareness regarding the dangers of consuming unverified liquor.
